title: Custom MCP connector entry
description: Contract for a connector the user adds that is not in catalog.json. The installer validates each custom answer against this before merging it into .mcp.json. Once written, a custom entry is indistinguishable from a catalog entry.

id.description: Server name as it appears under mcpServers. Lowercase, digits and hyphens.

transport.description: http and sse need url. stdio needs command.

url.description: Required for http and sse. Forbidden for stdio.

command.description: Required for stdio. Forbidden for http and sse.

headerName.description: Optional auth header name, e.g. Authorization.

credentialEnvVar.description: Env var holding the credential. Referenced as ${VAR} so the secret itself is never written to .mcp.json.

env.description: Extra env vars for a stdio server.
